groq.name: Groq
groq.keyFormat: Starts with "gsk_" followed by alphanumeric characters
groq.description: Ultra-fast AI inference with Llama 3. Free tier includes 1M tokens per day.
groq.pricingNote: Free tier: 1M tokens/day. Paid plans available for higher usage.

0.tip: Use your email or Google account for quick registration
0.title: Create a Groq Account
0.description: Visit the Groq Console and sign up for a free account.

1.tip: Look for the key icon in the navigation menu
1.title: Navigate to API Keys
1.description: Once logged in, click "API Keys" in the left sidebar.

2.tip: Choose a descriptive name so you remember what it's for
2.title: Create New API Key
2.description: Click the "Create API Key" button. Give it a name like "HEKA Calendar".

3.tip: ⚠️ For security, Groq only shows the full key once. If you lose it, create a new one.
3.title: Copy Your API Key
3.description: Copy the generated key (starts with "gsk_"). Save it securely — you won't see it again.

4.tip: Your key is stored only on this device
4.title: Paste Key in HEKA
4.description: Return to this screen and paste your key below. Click "Test Connection" to verify.

ollama.name: Ollama (Local)
ollama.description: Run AI models entirely on your own device. Complete privacy, no internet needed after setup.
ollama.pricingNote: No costs. Requires capable hardware (8GB+ RAM recommended).

0.tip: Windows version is available through Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL2)
0.title: Download Ollama
0.description: Download and install Ollama for your operating system (Mac, Linux, or Windows).

1.tip: Llama 3 is recommended for best results. Models are several GB to download.
1.title: Install a Model
1.description: Open your terminal and run: ollama pull llama3 or ollama pull mistral

2.tip: The server runs by default on http://localhost:11434
2.title: Start Ollama Server
2.description: Run: ollama serve to start the local API server. Keep this terminal open.

3.tip: First run downloads the model. Subsequent runs are instant.
3.title: Verify Installation
3.description: Test by running: ollama run llama3 in another terminal. Type a test message.

4.tip: Ollama must be running whenever you want AI-enhanced readings
4.title: Connect HEKA
4.description: Enter the server URL (usually http://localhost:11434) below and test the connection.

New Moon.poem: In the void between breaths, all potential dwells. The seed waits in darkness, gathering courage to split its shell. Plant intentions now—they will grow with the light.
New Moon.title: THE DARK MYSTERY

Full Moon.poem: All that was hidden in darkness now reveals itself to light. The seed planted at New Moon breaks through the earth. Your work culminates. The world witnesses your fullness.
Full Moon.title: THE GREAT REVELATION

Last Quarter.poem: Half remains, half must go. What will you carry forward? What will you leave behind? The choice is yours, and yours alone.
Last Quarter.title: THE RELEASE

First Quarter.poem: Half light, half shadow—the decision hanging in balance. The path ahead requires action. Choose, and the universe conspires.
First Quarter.title: THE CROSSROADS

Waxing Gibbous.poem: Almost full, almost complete. Momentum builds like a wave reaching its crest. Refine, adjust, prepare for the revelation.
Waxing Gibbous.title: THE GATHERING

Waning Gibbous.poem: The light begins its gentle retreat, but wisdom remains. Share what you have learned. Teach others what fullness taught you.
Waning Gibbous.title: THE SHARING

Waxing Crescent.poem: A sliver of silver pierces the night. The dream begins to breathe, taking its first steps into form. Trust the unfolding.
Waxing Crescent.title: THE FIRST BREATH

Waning Crescent.poem: A silver whisper fading into blackness. Rest now. The work is done. Surrender to the darkness, knowing the light will return.
Waning Crescent.title: THE SURRENDER
